summary.en: A two-day personality-development and career-guidance workshop.
summary.kn: ಎರಡು ದಿನಗಳ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿತ್ವ ವಿಕಸನ ಮತ್ತು ವೃತ್ತಿ ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶನ ಕಾರ್ಯಾಗಾರ.

body: A comprehensive two-day workshop on personality development and career guidance was organized. IGNITE-10 marked an important milestone in the alumni association's commitment to student development and career counseling.
